|}<includeonly>[[Category:pages using deprecated templates]]</includeonly><noinclude>{{Deprecated|ChapItemsHdr|ChapItemsCell FE1|ChapItemsFtr}}

==Usage==
Use for item data on chapter pages. Only the item name is necessary for sprites, they've been taken care of in the coding. Even if there is only one item, use <code>itemlast</code> and <code>obtainlast</code> to ensure the template is rounded.
<pre>
{{ChapItems
|platform= platform abbreviation (i.e. snes, gba, gcn, wii, or ds)
|item1= First item
|obtain1= Obtainment method for first item
|item2= Second item
|obtain2= Obtainment method for second item
|itemlast=Final item
|obtainlast= Obtainment method for last item
}}
</pre>
[[Category:Chapter data templates]]
</noinclude>
